column7: Online UnlockUser cleared the login lockout, then wrote account.unlocked best-effort, so a failed audit append lifted a brute-force refusal with no chain record. The clear and the audit row now commit in one fail-closed transaction (UNLOCK-AUDIT-1): an audit error or panic rolls the clear back and the handler answers 503 audit_unavailable. Same fix and test as unlock-audit-user-unlock-audit-same-tx-001; this row records that #3428 itself is closed. Red/green re-run by CORE-ORDER-RACES-NOV-1 (2026-11-14): TestUnlockUser_AuditWriteError_LeavesLockoutSet and TestUnlockUser_AuditWritePanic_LeavesLockoutSet fail at b2f7a8962 (pre-fix) and pass at e1d550c61.
